run_scenario_hf_demo_mcp: run the HuggingFace demo scenario with MCP apps via the CLI entry point
init_and_populate_apps: initialize and populate the scenario with apps loaded from HuggingFace and MCP JSON config
load_mcp_apps_from_json: load additional MCP apps from a JSON file specified by the MCP_APPS_JSON_PATH environment variable
create_mcp_app: create an MCPApp instance from a server config supporting SSE remote or local command-based servers
register_scenario_hf_demo_mcp: register the ScenarioHuggingFaceDemoMCP class under the name scenario_hf_demo_mcp in the scenario registry
